bio: Afternoon Tea Awards 2024 - Award of Excellence  L’oscar London, a luxurious boutique hotel, have launched their new Afternoon Tea, inspired by the historical grade II* listed building that was once the headquarters of the Baptist Church.  L’oscar London is located in the heart of London’s Southampton Row, close to Covent Garden, Theatreland, Soho, and the West End. Built between 1901 and 1903, in a style coined “Edwardian Free Baroque”, it was the London headquarters of the Baptist Church, and has since been restored by world renowned French decorator, Jacques Garcia.  Afternoon Tea at L’oscar is served in L’oscar Restaurant which features an illuminated Onyx bar with ceilings lined with mirrors, gilded panels and stunning original art. The restaurant offers all the charm and sophistication of a Parisian café. In true tradition, guests can expect delicious savoury and dainty sandwiches including roast heritage beef, caramelised onions, gherkins and watercress on tomato bread, and smoked Scottish salmon roulade with keda caviar and chervil on rye bread. Sweet treats on offer include delicately crafted cakes such as a chocolate & pistachio praline tart and a Choux Bun with white wine rhubarb & strawberry compote.  To cleanse the palate, guests can choose from flutes of Champagne or a selection of loose tea leaves from Newby.  Afternoon Tea is served Friday – 2:30pm – 5:00pm and Saturday & Sunday – 12:00pm – 5:00pm and costs £59 per person, or £69 with a glass of Champagne.
